rationale: The bounded product-semantics change requires a structured path, but the supplied facts do not indicate broad runtime, architecture, policy, persistence, security, API, CLI, release, or cross-host impact. Compact Delivery is ineligible because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are not evidenced. Verified Change is also ineligible because ownership is distributed across three canonical owners and propagation is not deterministic.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Product semantics impact is true, requiring governed delivery beyond an ungated quick or trivial change.
Three canonical owners are affected, so the one-owner Verified Change condition is not met.
Four derived paths exist and deterministic propagation is false, independently disqualifying Verified Change.
Compact Delivery prerequisites are incomplete: no completed Brownfield analysis or stored quick_task context is supplied
All broader impact flags are false, supporting structured_slice rather than structured_delivery.
Any impact beyond the supplied facts requires fail-closed escalation.
